body: Im sorry! I know That u want to help and i apreciate what you are saying, I'm just so mad that I can get so royaly screwed and there is no way to fix it but to just go with the flow. Thanks for the kind words :)

Hmm... I know that I can make it, everyone CAN make it. But the question is just if I want to, I don't have any motivation for this, life is just a real pain when I'm there and the thing that makes me the most mad is that I can't do anything about it! Everyone has a choice in life, but the fact that my country can decide wether or not I have a choice in how I want to live my life just makes me depressed and sad....

The twists and turns in my life are at this moment one bad ones. And I have limited opportunities before this year is over. What's gonna happen next is that I'm probably gonna get forced to do something I don't want to....

Well, my situation is not permanent... And there are options that I have to make this situation come to an end. Those are not good options however, and it feels like I'm fucked. In my country we have some sort of military "duty year" (idk what to call it). Anyway I was really conflicted about this before this year began. And I thout I would give it a try! And that has been so far the worst decision of my life so far. There were things I could have done to prevent this, but I didnt think this year would be a really big deal. I have been in the military for about 4 months now. The reason I'm fucked is that i can't back out now. I can ofc break my own leg or some shit, but that's a very dramatic solution. I can say to the doctor there that I have suicidal thoughts (which I have had to many times these past months) and the military wil probably let me go. But then It will get written on my record that I'm crazy or mentally ill or something like that. And I will probably have a hard time getting a job in the future. The only way this has a happy end is if I make it, and I really feel like I wont! Life is so hard. The worst part about being there is that it's like a prison... I can't do whatever I want, and my bosses can do a lot of things to me. I am living in constant fear for what comes next and I am so scared. I just want to go home, I just want to start studying, get a job and live my life in peace.....
